title: Over-Roasted Argentinian Apples Gratin
description: A savory, crunchy, and comforting dish from Argentina, perfect for a sick day. This gratin is made with Braeburn apples and rendered fat.
instructions: Preheat the fondue pot over medium-high heat.
Add the rendered pork fat and olive oil to the fondue pot.
Add the sliced apples and cook until they start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the fresh rosemary sprigs and cook for 1 minute.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the apple mixture to a baking dish and top with grated Parmesan cheese.
Transfer the fondue pot to the oven and roast at 425°F for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown and the apples are tender.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
